_doc: Tools the Project Eyas frontend (and IR playbook) depends on at runtime. Bumping this list is the contract for sidecar deploys: make-dist.sh validates the bundled sidecar registers every name here; /api/health surfaces missing entries so a partial deploy is visible before the operator hits a broken page. Frontend-referenced names come from grepping app/lib/components for `extras_*`; IR-workflow names come from falcon-extras/ir_playbook.py since the agent calls those by name. Add an entry whenever a new tool becomes load-bearing for a route, primer, or playbook step.
_doc_required_params: An entry may be a plain string (name-only check) OR an object {"name": ..., "required_params": [...]}. The object form additionally pins the agent-facing parameter contract: verify_tools.py asserts every listed param still appears in the registered tool's input schema, so a modular-refactor wrapper-signature drift (a dropped or renamed gated-tool param) fails the build instead of NameError-ing only when the tool fires. Seed required_params ONLY for safety-critical write tools where a missing param is dangerous. This pins the wrapper / agent-facing contract; it does NOT do full wrapper-to-impl dataflow (a kwarg mismatch that only errors at call time is still caught only by the AST sweep + /audit-write-tools).
